code: library(malariafwd) check_setup()   # SLiM, the model, and Python with tskit                 # the first call builds reticulate's Python environment: a few hundred MB, once  # one run: 100 hosts and 250 mosquitoes for 18 months, a few seconds on a modern laptop. p   <- vivax_params(N_HOSTS = 100, N_MOSQ = 250, BITING_RATE = 0.1, SIM_DAYS = 548) run <- run_sim(p, seed = 1, outdir = file.path(tempdir(), "demo")) # every parameter, its unit and the values it may take: ?vivax_params or param_info() # no SLiM yet? every call below also takes the run that ships with the package: # run <- example_run()  # the headline numbers, over the run's second half: prevalence, complexity of infection (COI), # entomological inoculation rate (EIR), force of infection (FOI), molecular force of blood-stage # infection (molFOB), relapses summarise_run(run)  # one call, several panels: did the run settle, saturate or go extinct? plot_diagnostics(run)  # one host: its blood-stage clones coloured by lineage, over the hypnozoites it carries ev   <- load_events(run)                 # one row per event; ?events.tsv describes the columns host <- ev[event_type == "hypnozoite_activation", .N, by = human_id][order(-N), human_id[1]] plot_host_trajectory(run, host)  # the population: who is infected, and who carries only an invisible reservoir plot_host_state_prevalence(run)  # clones arriving (molFOB) against infections arriving (FOI) plot_force_of_infection(run)  # ground-truth IBD by known relationship, read from the recorded genealogy plot_relatedness_ladder(run, style = "bars")  # the same IBD as segments along the 14 PvP01 chromosomes tp   <- ibd_truth_pairs(run) pick <- tp[cls %in% c("relapse vs its origin", "same-oocyst sibs", "distinct founders"),            .SD[1], by = cls] plot_ibd_pair(run, pick$a, pick$b, labels = sprintf("%s\nIBD %.2f", pick$cls, pick$ibd))
